content: gfx1100 math-library status: hipBLASLt officially requires gfx90a/gfx94x/gfx110x cards (gfx1100 supported, tensilelite); PyTorch added gfx110X to preferred hipBLASLt archs. rocWMMA officially supports gfx1100/gfx1101/gfx1102 wave32 as gfx11 (current 2.x). rocBLAS supports gfx1100 via fallback kernels.
